purpose: Define predicted/simulated observations as evidence distinct from real operation results and prohibit simulated success from mutating production state.

topics.name: Simulation Result Boundary
topics.purpose: Define predicted/simulated observations as evidence distinct from real operation results and prohibit simulated success from mutating production state.

semantics.identity_rule: Each simulation result has explicit evidence identity.
semantics.run_rule: Result references exact sandbox/dry-run/mock/fault test execution.
semantics.status_rule: Simulation success/failure is distinct from production success/failure.
semantics.comparison_rule: Simulation may be compared to later real execution through explicit comparison evidence.
semantics.authority_rule: Simulation result cannot be used as proof an effect actually occurred.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

hard_gates.condition: predicted hash stored as real artifact hash
mock result treated live endpoint result
